title: Fast Iterative Combinatorial Auctions via Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.30667v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Iterative combinatorial auctions are used in spectrum allocation, transportation, and industrial procurement, but rounds are costly. We introduce FastCombo, a deep reinforcement learning approach to sequential price discovery. Bayesian pricing has sharply reduced auction rounds even against subgradient benchmarks tuned with hindsight for each instance, but relies on a one-step objective and repeated online inference and optimization. We prove that greedily maximizing immediate clearing probability can require arbitrarily more rounds in expectation than an informative policy, even with the true valuation distribution known. FastCombo learns price policies offline, assigning credit to queries for the future decisions they enable and producing each online price update with a single neural-network forward pass. translated_title: 基于深度强化学习的快速迭代组合拍卖
translated_abstract: 迭代组合拍卖被应用于频谱分配、交通运输和工业采购等场景，但拍卖轮次代价高昂。我们提出了FastCombo，一种用于序贯价格发现的深度强化学习方法。贝叶斯定价即使与针对每个实例用事后信息调优的次梯度基准相比，也能显著减少拍卖轮次，但其依赖于单步目标以及反复的在线推理与优化。我们证明，即使已知真实的估值分布，贪婪地最大化即时出清概率的策略在期望意义上也可能需要任意多的额外轮次。FastCombo在离线阶段学习定价策略，为那些能够促成未来决策的查询分配信用，并通过单次神经网络前向传播生成每次在线价格更新。我们将单需求拍卖中最小化到出清的期望轮次的目标形式化为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（摘要至此截断）。
tldr: FastCombo通过离线深度强化学习为迭代组合拍卖学习序贯定价策略，以单次神经网络前向传播完成价格更新，从理论上克服了单步贪婪定价的局限，并显著减少拍卖出清所需的轮次。
en_tdlr: FastCombo learns sequential pricing policies for iterative combinatorial auctions via offline deep reinforcement learning, updating prices with a single neural-network forward pass to overcome the limits of myopic greedy pricing and substantially reduce the rounds needed to reach clearing.
